scope: Personal filesystem paths and execution identities only
json_policy: Keep all fields and list entries; substitute private path/identity strings and preserve source SHA256
csv_policy: Copied byte-for-byte; no metric tokens or path columns changed
binary_policy: Nine scorer checkpoints copied byte-for-byte after static ZIP and pickle-operand inspection; no model loading
history_policy: Historical ZIP containers, retired diagnosis/alarms/global-routing studies and superseded detection snapshots are excluded. Two still-current synthetic retrieval studies are selected from their original archives without recomputing results.
excluded: private execution logs and commands outside selected summaries
limits: Integrity and packaging checks do not reproduce training, metrics or confidence intervals
licensing: No separate open-data or open-model license is selected. The original-code license does not automatically relicense results, checkpoints or third-party assets; release authority remains the author's responsibility.
